changelog:
- Dedicated Open Audio & Music Hub: Spotify-style dark interface for ad-free high-quality 320kbps streams (Lo-Fi, Acoustic, Peace & Zen 432Hz, Piano, Jazz, Synthwave) with sticky mini player.
- Replaced Save with Audio: Preserved Favorites while swapping the redundant Save button with the new Audio Hub.
- True Pinterest Visuals & Wallpapers Feed: Staggered 2-column cards with title and 3-dots action sheet matching Pinterest.
- Fixed Startpage Wallpaper Application: Instant and permanent wallpaper setting via native bridge and global theme.
- Dynamic Keyword Search Across Media: Search whatever you type across Visuals, Audio, and Video.
- Uninterrupted Background & Screen-Off Playback: Enhanced Foreground Media Playback service with partial wake lock prevents Android from pausing YouTube or audio when the screen is turned off or apps are switched.
